evaluations.evidence: view a list of sponsors
evaluations.rationale: Single requirement: presenting a list of sponsors is one implementable/testable feature.

evaluations.evidence: view a list of user profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: display a list of user profiles.

evaluations.evidence: email all the trainers at once from the website
evaluations.rationale: One feature: bulk email trainers via the website.

evaluations.evidence: have a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: provide a clear map showing buildings/rooms (attributes of the map).

evaluations.evidence: edit my training node myself
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allow trainers to edit their training node; 'links to slides' are attributes of the content.

evaluations.evidence: limit to one registration per day per authenticated user
evaluations.rationale: Single constraint/feature: enforce one registration per user per day.

evaluations.evidence: have an admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: an admin view to track registration status (includes status values as attributes).

evaluations.evidence: be added to a training waitlist
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: add attendee to training waitlist.

evaluations.evidence: must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: require acceptance of cancellation terms via checkbox.

evaluations.evidence: tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: integrate a cancellation deadline into the existing workflow.

evaluations.evidence: add to "my schedule"
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allow adding items to the user's personal schedule (conditional clause is not a separate feature).

evaluations.evidence: see which trainings I have signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: show a user's enrolled trainings.

evaluations.evidence: have a view that is attached to their training node that shows all attendee information
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: a trainer-facing view showing attendee information (privacy justification is contextual, not a separate feature).

evaluations.evidence: admin view where all trainee information is shown and can be filtered
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: an admin trainee information view with filtering (filtering is an attribute of the view).

evaluations.evidence: dedicated page for each class ... The URL path should be SEO friendly /training/training-title
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable/testable features: a detailed class page (content fields and map) and a separate SEO-friendly URL routing requirement (friendly URL structure/social sharing). These can be implemented and prioritized separately.

evaluations.evidence: training options clearly marked for the following information
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: a training listing presentation that enumerates attributes to display (enumeration of attributes is allowed).

evaluations.evidence: training landing page with an intro section and a list of all training offerings
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: create a landing page; multiple sections are attributes of that page.

evaluations.evidence: have a link on the home page to a list of training options
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: add a homepage link to training listings.

evaluations.evidence: find out where the coding lounge is and what time it is open
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: provide location and opening hours for the coding lounge (both are part of the same info feature).

evaluations.evidence: refund sponsorship money that was processed via stripe
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: process refunds for Stripe payments.

evaluations.evidence: find a link on the sponsorships page to become a $350 level sponsor
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: add a link to the sponsorship page for a specific sponsorship level.

evaluations.evidence: See a list of attendees associated with this company
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: display attendees for a company.

evaluations.evidence: identify myself as and pay for a $350 company sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: Viewed as one transaction flow (select/identify sponsorship and pay) rather than independent features; treated as a single purchase feature.

evaluations.evidence: create and maintain venues
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: venue management (create/maintain as CRUD operations are part of one management feature).

evaluations.evidence: view venue details
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing venue detail information.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of the sessions associated with sponsor attendees
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: show sessions associated with sponsor attendees.

evaluations.evidence: See a payment page to pay for my individual sponsorships as the third step of the registration process
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: provide a payment page as part of registration flow.

evaluations.evidence: assign sponsors to events, trainings and summits
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: a sponsor-assignment capability that applies across types; supporting multiple types is an attribute of the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all events, trainings and summits that a sponsor is sponsoring
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: listing sponsorships across types (types are attributes of the listing).

evaluations.evidence: Enter payment information and have my card charged for an individual sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: payment entry and charging as one transaction flow.

evaluations.evidence: link BADCamp attendees to my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: associate attendees with a sponsor page (linking is one capability).

evaluations.evidence: update my user profile
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: profile update capability.

evaluations.evidence: sign up for the BADCamp newsletter
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: newsletter signup.

evaluations.evidence: tag my blog posts for consumption by Drupal Planet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: tagging blog posts for an external aggregator.

evaluations.evidence: create blog posts
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: blog post creation capability.

evaluations.evidence: read the blog
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: blog reading/viewing.

evaluations.evidence: sponsor a summit that matches my brand
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: sponsor a summit (selection based on brand is part of the selection criteria).

evaluations.evidence: register for a summit
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: summit registration.

evaluations.evidence: get detailed directions to the summit venue
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: provide detailed directions to the venue.

evaluations.evidence: see what summits I'm signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: show user's signed-up summits.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of attendees signed up for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: summit coordinator attendee list (with email communication as purpose, not a separate feature).

evaluations.evidence: list basic information about my summit
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: publish basic summit information.

evaluations.evidence: list sponsors for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: display sponsors for a summit.

evaluations.evidence: list an agenda for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: publish a summit agenda.

evaluations.evidence: see how many seats are left for the summit
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: display remaining seat count.

evaluations.evidence: see specific details on summits
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: show detailed summit information.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: list all summits.

evaluations.evidence: learn about sponsorship levels
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: provide information about sponsorship levels.

evaluations.evidence: use a WYSIWYG editor for all long-form content
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: provide WYSIWYG editing for long-form content.

evaluations.evidence: Link to my sponsorship profile from my job listings
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: add a link from job listings to sponsorship profile.

evaluations.evidence: learn about posting jobs as a sponsor and contact the sponsorship person
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: a sponsor-facing info/contact page that contains both info and contact (attributes of one page), not separate independent features.

evaluations.evidence: post a job
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: job posting capability for sponsors.

evaluations.evidence: view the job board
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the job board.

evaluations.evidence: assign a room to a time slot and a location
evaluations.rationale: Single scheduling feature: assigning rooms to timeslots/locations is part of the same schedule-population capability.

evaluations.evidence: see the schedule
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: provide schedule viewing.

evaluations.evidence: see the final list of sessions approved
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: display final approved sessions.

evaluations.evidence: bulk approve sessions as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: bulk approval action for sessions.

evaluations.evidence: mark a session as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: mark individual session as accepted.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when sessions have been evaluated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: notification on evaluation outcome.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when I submit a session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: submission confirmation notification.

evaluations.evidence: edit my session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ability for user to edit their session submission.

evaluations.evidence: register to speak at BADCamp, so that I submit a session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: register to speak/submit a session is one related flow.

evaluations.evidence: submit a session at BADCAMP
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: session submission capability.

evaluations.evidence: personalize my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allow sponsors to personalize their page.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits that include when they are
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: list summits including dates/times (attributes of the list).

evaluations.evidence: Be offered several choices of idividual sponsorship on the second page of registration
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: offer sponsorship choices in the registration flow (presentation of choices is one feature).

evaluations.evidence: easily find a link in the menu that links to the registration form
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: add a menu link to registration form.

evaluations.evidence: fill out a user registration form
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: user registration form submission.

evaluations.evidence: find session information
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: discover/find session information.
